_doc: How the player's tools step and reach (game/tools), interaction choices of this game with no norm behind them. drawn_px: the width of an outline a tool draws (a lot, a demolition), screen pixels. brush: between dabs along a stroke a share of the radius (step_share) and never closer than step_least_m; a pointer back from far away lays at most most_steps dabs at once. handle: a building handle turns in turn_steps steps a turn (Shift free). lots: what of a corner or a side the pointer takes (take_px, screen pixels); how far a lot's point reaches for a footway or a corner (catch_px at this zoom, never less than snap_least_m); the marks' size (mark_m). roundabout: [ and ] scale by scale_step. terrain: one dab per dab_s held, which keeps each step above the 1 cm height quantum. zone: a new dab once the brush moved dab_spacing of its radius; a fast drag paints the whole way, up to most_dabs at a report; the zone a stroke paints when none was chosen (default_zone, a zones.json id).
